recommendation: #129: recommend Behaviour B not ported and Behaviour A as A1 (Phobos's private clone, riding the next freeze)

RECOMMENDATION for #129 (tenant CPU AI), to be put to the maintainer, whose decision it is ([VSP-10]; the 14z-196 order "captures first", rulings_reads.txt): Behaviour B (vs2's low-attack crouch-guard test, shared engine code) — NOT PORTED; Behaviour A (Phobos's guard in the in-move continuation check) — A1, a private clone for Phobos — repointing BOTH of his ported calls of the unguarded check to it: the jsr at PRG:0x41D406 (options.txt: 4 bytes in a vs2-ported region, 0 legacy bytes and 0 legacy executions by the measured reach) and the jsr 0x2D374 at PRG:0x416312 inside his private handler 0x416234 (options.txt's 14z-215 correction: reached on ours 53, 11, 31 and 11 times; options.txt's own A1 text, written before that correction, names only 0x41D406), landing with the next scheduled freeze rather than a freeze of its own; #129 then stays open until that freeze ships A1 (done-awaiting-release), or, if the maintainer declines A1, closes as not ported. The reasons: B — the maintainer's read of the matched-start capture is "seems like our build is similar to vs2 from what I see" (rulings_reads.txt), and the faithful port of B hooks five SHARED vsavj blocks (30 legacy bytes, every CPU's crouch decision, the attract demo) for a CPU-only behaviour, against the superset invariant's cost; A — the maintainer's read is "test is correct, behaviour is different but seems somewhat consistent between vs2 and our build" (rulings_reads.txt), the measured difference is real and one-directional (a_table.txt / captures_A_B_report.md: over 15 Phobos legs per side native refuses all 3,396 continuation checks with +0x1BC != 0, ours has no guard and takes 36 second continuations in 9 of 15 legs), and A1 removes it with no legacy exposure, where A2 would move legacy timing in every 1P-vs-CPU match. NOT TESTED / what this rests on: the second route — over these legs every call through 0x416312 had +0x1BC = 0 (options.txt; captures_A_B_report.md), so it has not yet shown the guard's case, and coverage beyond these legs is not measured (options.txt); repointing it too makes A1 independent of that observation, but its cost and its legacy reach are not separately measured (options.txt's "no legacy fighter id reached any ported caller in any leg or replay" is the only reach evidence, and the static cost estimate covers the 0x41D406 call alone); A1 is NOT built — its cost (~92 cycles a frame for Phobos at most, ~0.05%) is a STATIC estimate (options.txt), its effect in play is not captured, and a built A1 would be measured and its capture shown to the maintainer before any freeze takes it; the reads are visual reads of a small set (Behaviour A: three sheet pairs on the soak rig's active leg; B: nine matched-start pairs, one rig, P1 dash + standing LK/MK, level 6, six RNG words, captures_B_matched_report.md "NOT CAPTURED"); the matched-start capture itself measured a difference the read does not dwell on — in accepted pairs the events split neither/ours-only/native-only/both Phobos 59/7/4/3, Pyron 45/12/7/24, Donovan 18/7/5/43, and wherever the native event fired the CPU's first reaction id was 0xFF natively and 0x02 on ours (captures_B_matched_report.md) — so "not ported" for B accepts a measured mechanistic difference on the strength of the visual read, which is the maintainer's to weigh; the CPU states diverge before the press in most candidates (211/325, 196/325, 167/265 refused) for reasons not measured; nothing on FBNeo or MiSTer; whether vsavj opponents' +0x8C record carries vs2's meaning is moot only if B is not ported; #129 is the lowest-priority open ticket by the 14z-196 ruling and the CPU AI is a single-player surface. No gameplay change is made by this recommendation; the decision is the maintainer's.
